sources.snippet: FP16 QNN context binaries and a standalone Android runner converted from Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-.6B-hf. The tested target is Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / SM8650 / Hexagon HTP V75, using QAIRT 2.51.40.260930 on Samsung SM-F741U with Android 14. Download the runtime files into one directory and run qwen_runner with the matching Qualcomm runtime.
